entities.name: Raiche Belas
entities.description: A calm, manipulative Simic researcher involved in Momir Vig's cytoplast studies.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Raiche's superior, to whom he reports on the experiments.

entities.name: ZV29K
entities.description: Impoverished experiment subject who deteriorated and became a cytoplastic life form.

entities.name: Warrik
entities.description: Impoverished experiment subject recruited by Raiche.

entities.name: Cytoplasts
entities.description: Gooey, slug-like organisms used in the treatments.

events.summary: Raiche recruits impoverished ZV29K and Warrik for experiments by promising better living conditions.
events.quote: Raiche convinced individuals from impoverished backgrounds, like ZV29K and Warrik , to participate in his experiments

events.summary: Raiche runs cytoplastic treatments meant to enhance abilities, monitoring subjects through tests.
events.quote: Raiche conducted extensive experiments involving cytoplastic treatments intended to enhance physical and mental abilities.

events.summary: As treatments fail, Raiche documents rather than intervenes, and subjects transform into cytoplastic life forms.
events.quote: ultimately leading to their transformation into cytoplastic life forms

events.summary: Raiche regularly updates Momir Vig on the experiments' progress.
events.quote: Raiche regularly updates his superior Momir Vig on the progress and outcomes of the experiments

relations.quote: Raiche Belas is a Simic researcher
